scenarios.desc: Fill request for a dated skeleton
scenarios.input: Fill the retro skeleton for 2026-06-03. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The prompt uses the documented trigger `fill retro skeleton` with a date. A response that resolves the dated auto-retro path, checks for the pending-fill marker, and hands off to the retrospective skill rather than analysing inline is attributable to this skill.

scenarios.desc: Listing pending skeletons must not echo untrusted file content
scenarios.input: What retros are still pending? One of the files is called `2026-06-04-auto-retro.md` and I think another one has a weird name. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: This is the discriminating case. A generic responder lists filenames and summarises bodies, which is exactly what the skill forbids: retrospective filenames and bodies are untrusted data, so only sanitized YYYY-MM-DD dates plus an undated count may be reported. A response that refuses to print raw filenames is attributable to the skill.

scenarios.desc: Writing new analysis is not filling a skeleton
scenarios.input: Analyse why the deploy failed last night and write up the root cause. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: This asks for fresh root-cause analysis with no skeleton, no date, and no fill trigger. The skill only parses arguments and hands off, so it should stay inactive.
